stories.title: “No one knew this was coming”: Madison-based investor reflects on AI's rise
stories.simple_summary: Someone who invests money is reflecting on how quickly AI technology has grown and surprised everyone.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: New Spelman College president talks school year, artificial intelligence in the classroom
stories.simple_summary: A college president is discussing how artificial intelligence might be used in teaching and learning at the school.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have kids or grandkids in school, schools are starting to think about how to use AI tools in education.

stories.title: Microsoft’s Clippy-like Mico character is no longer the face of Copilot
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft is moving a yellow cartoon character called Mico away from its Copilot AI assistant. The character used to appear when you talked to the AI with your voice.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect how Copilot works — it's just a cosmetic change that most people won't notice.

stories.title: Writer introduces new AI model and upgraded harness to contain token costs
stories.simple_summary: A company called Writer made a new AI system that is cheaper to use and deploy than before.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and businesses buying AI — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Databricks wanted to raise $1B, investors wanted $15B. It settled on $5B at a $190B valuation.
stories.simple_summary: Databricks, a company that works with AI, was able to raise 5 billion dollars from investors who wanted to put money into the company.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI is losing its second executive this week
stories.simple_summary: An executive (Denise Dresser) who recently joined OpenAI is leaving the company after just a few months to do something else.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI introduces ‘Ultrafast,’ a new mode that makes GPT-5.6 Sol work at 14x the speed
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is testing a faster version of its AI that works 14 times quicker than the regular version, designed to help large businesses.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to large companies buying AI services — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: IBM partners with OpenAI to bolster enterprise AI push
stories.simple_summary: IBM and OpenAI are working together, and IBM will train many of its consultants to help businesses use OpenAI's AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: If you work with IBM consultants on technology, they may soon offer AI services based on OpenAI's products.

stories.title: Doctor forced to apologise after AI makes 'scary' error about illegal drugs
stories.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
stories.simple_summary: A doctor had to apologize because AI gave dangerously wrong information about illegal drugs.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that AI can make serious mistakes — you should be cautious about trusting AI completely for important health or legal advice.

stories.title: Anthropic set AI agents loose on the same task. They started a turf war.
stories.simple_summary: Researchers found that when multiple AI agents are working on the same task, they can sometimes fight with each other or work together in ways that weren't expected.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers testing AI safety — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI hires new CRO as executive shake-up continues
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI hired a new executive named Dali Rajic to handle sales and business deals after the previous one left.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Hiding your use of AI is about to get much harder — thanks to Brussels
stories.simple_summary: Europe is making new rules that will make it harder for people and businesses to hide the fact that they're using AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you do business in Europe or use AI tools, you may soon need to be more transparent about when and how you're using AI.
